checks: native Food.update directly calls private updateRotting
native rot replacement follows updateAge and isRotten
native rotten-removal setting can delete an existing food
isRotten compares actual age against threshold rather than the legacy boolean flag
isPowered queries current object power and contains no power-history lookup
installed frame order is pre-event, world update, GameTime helper, post-event
pre-event runs before the exit-save branch
generator maintains current activation, fuel, and last processed hour
SP cell processes native items before moving objects and players
OnPlayerUpdate can restore transient food shields before the normal player superclass update
player superclass update owns timed-action updates and completion
OnSave fires before the current cell is serialized
source: javap -p -c against the current installed game JAR
limits: Static control-flow audit. It does not validate world streaming, UI rendering, or native hook interoperation in a game session.
